lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 9 distinct vertical line segments of varying lengths are visible. Spacing is irregular, with the widest gap between the 1st and 2nd anterior lines and the highest density located in the mid-torso region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Significant discontinuities are observed in the 1st, 2nd, 8th, and 9th lines; the 1st and 9th segments exist only as short dorsal dashes, failing to traverse the lower half of the torso mass.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Low density cluster consisting of approximately 5 distinct white spots localized on the upper hindquarter and the lateral surface of the thigh.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: A horizontal alignment of three discrete spots is visible on the lateral posterior haunch, roughly parallel to the ground plane.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The visible horn follows a lyrate trajectory, originating at a posterior-dorsal angle from the skull before spiraling inward and upward.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The high-contrast ivory tip accounts for approximately 10 to 15 percent of the total vertical length of the visible horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: A prominent white dorsal crest of hair extends along the spine; a distinct white chevron-shaped patch is visible on the lower neck/throat region; bright orange-yellow coloration is present on the lower limbs below the carpus and tarsus.
